main_text.l: mortuos ad vitam refuscitauit, ipse vi-
tæ fons mortem patienter tulit ; qui li-
contra se lata, ne querulam vocem
cinctu habuit ad suppetias ferendas, ne
gladium quidem in iuftiffima fui de-
tiam oftenderet, ideò fanauit vt poten-
iurio fupra modum infamis effet; ita fe
geffit Saluator nofter, cuius omnis actio

page.notes: Left column is blank. "querulam" is read as printed; a doubtful letter form, not certain. The text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The reference marks i, k, l and m are placed in the text where they stand. The left note for m is read as "Vide S[?]et." (possibly Suet.), as the second letter is unclear.
